# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 yuan-restore1, the Yuan's restoration route, phase 1 (oe_yr_). Generated by gen_yuan_restore.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 39 "yr") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on has_global_variable = oe_yr_note NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_init } }.
# This line writes no monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.2): start, the notice of an abandonment, the end, the
# intensity written back, then before the opening the two runs and the opening, after it the abandonment checks, the
# checklist, the strain; January's renewal; the events.
oe_yr_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_init } } oe_yr_setup = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } oe_yr_note_step = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
        oe_yr_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
            oe_yr_resync = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } } oe_yr_watch_open = yes }
            else = { oe_yr_step = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_yr_settled_apply = yes }
            oe_yr_ev_pick = yes
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
}
# Any scope. The first run in a game: before 1373.1.1, with the suppression line in the mod and a Mongol Yuan the line opens
# (not yet the restoration: that waits for the four ways). Otherwise it stays off (oe_yr_end 8).
oe_yr_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yr_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1373.1.1 oe_yr_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_yr_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_path value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_int_d value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p3run value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ever1 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_yr: the line runs (the restoration opens from 1355.1.1 by one of four ways)"
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_end value = 8 } debug_log = "oe_yr: too late, no suppression line or no Mongol Yuan: the line stays off (code 8)" }
}
# Any scope (F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS, a hook; also this line's own monthly check). The Yuan has fallen: the line ends with code 3.
# Vanilla's modifiers of the Yuan are left as they are (the dynasty is gone); this line's own come off.
oe_yr_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on } oe_yr_finish = { code = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_note }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The end: the collapse or no longer a Mongol Yuan (3), 1400.1.1 (5: the stage modifiers come off; the
# lasting ones of phase 3 would stay).
oe_yr_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_yuan_ok = no } oe_yr_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1400.1.1 } oe_yr_finish = { code = 5 } }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_yr_finish = { code = N }: this line's modifiers off, the line closed (oe_yr_end = N), nothing due.
oe_yr_finish = {
    oe_yr_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yr_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_end value = $code$ }
    debug_log = "oe_yr: the line ends (code in oe_yr_end)"
}
# Any scope. Removes this line's own modifiers from the Yuan (phase 1: oe_yr_settled).
oe_yr_strip = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } } }
}
# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line (global oe_dbg_n_yr).
oe_yr_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yr } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yr value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yr add = 1 }
}
# Any scope, monthly before the opening (design 3.2 step 3): the two runs, the window, the opening.
oe_yr_watch_open = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 3 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p3run add = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p3run value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 3 } has_global_variable = oe_y7_shi global_var:oe_y7_shi >= 60 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { current_date >= 1373.1.1 } oe_yr_finish = { code = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_can_open = yes } oe_yr_do_open = yes }
}
# Any scope. The opening: the way (first that holds), the month, the literacy now (phase 3 compares with it), .1 due.
oe_yr_do_open = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yr_opened
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_way_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_way_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_way_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 3 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 4 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_open_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_lit0 value = average_country_literacy } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d1 value = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_yr: the restoration opens (way [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_how')|0])"
}
# Any scope, monthly once open (design 3.2 steps 4-6): the abandonment checks ③ ④, then with a road the checklist and the
# strain (and ① ②), without one .1 again after a deferment or when it went unanswered.
oe_yr_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_dadu_lost = yes } oe_yr_abort = { why = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_y7_lost = yes } oe_yr_abort = { why = 4 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } }
        oe_yr_checks = yes
        oe_yr_strain_step = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 global_var:oe_yr_strain >= 12 }
            oe_yr_abort = { why = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_ever1 ?= 1 } global_var:oe_yr_m >= oe_yr_ten_m }
            oe_yr_abort = { why = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1 global_var:oe_yr_strain >= 12 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } oe_yr_asked_7 = no }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d7 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_on
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 }
            oe_yr_asked_1 = no
            OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_defer_m } global_var:oe_yr_m >= global_var:oe_yr_defer_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d1 value = 1 }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly with a road (design 3.4). Stage 0: the checklist of stage 1, held months, .2 due after 6 months
# (not while vanilla's crisis of the Chinese dynasty is active). Stage 1: stage 2 is phase 2 of the design (not built):
# nothing is counted. PHASE 2: the checklists of stage 2 A and B go here.
oe_yr_checks = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = oe_yr_ok1_calc }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 3 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_stage1_ok = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yr_hold >= 6 oe_yr_crisis = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d2 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly with a road (design 3.6): any signal +1, else -1, 0-12.
oe_yr_strain_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_strain_sig = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain add = 1 } }
    else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain add = -1 } }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain min = 0 max = 12 }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.3). Usage: oe_yr_add_strain = { amount = N }: the strain changes by N (0-12) while the
# restoration has a road (the Korean line's 1364 war, the coast could use it).
oe_yr_add_strain = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yr_open = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain add = $amount$ }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain min = 0 max = 12 }
    }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_yr_abort = { why = N }: the restoration is abandoned (oe_yr_end 2; design 3.6: 1 strain before stage
# 1, 2 ten years without stage 1, 3 Dadu lost, 4 the suppression lost). Every cut of vanilla's modifiers is put back, this
# line's modifiers come off; the notice (.7, the variant with one option) follows through oe_yr_note.
oe_yr_abort = {
    oe_yr_fall_back_all = yes
    oe_yr_finish = { code = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_why value = $why$ }
    set_global_variable = oe_yr_note
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
}
# Any scope, monthly after an abandonment: the notice is sent once (it waits at most 2 busy months), then the line rests.
oe_yr_note_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yr_busy = no global_var:oe_yr_wait >= 2 } }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_note
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 7 }
        oe_yr_count = yes
        debug_log = "oe_yr: the notice of the abandonment (oe_yr.7) sent to CHI"
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yr.7 } }
    }
    else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait add = 1 } }
}
# ---- the reward and its undoing (no debug_log: .7 a reaches these through the worker)
# Any scope. Stage 1 passed (design 3.4): stage 1, the hold and the stage's "hold on" cleared, the cut recorded (oe_yr_cut
# bit 1 and the amount actually changed), the intensity -0.25, legitimacy +5; from 1368 on oe_yr_settled.
oe_yr_pass_1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ever1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = -0.25 }
    oe_yr_set_strife = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_last_d } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut1_amt value = global_var:oe_yr_last_d } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1 } } set_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1 change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus } }
    oe_yr_settled_apply = yes
}
# Any scope. Back to before stage 1 (.7 a): the intensity changed back by the amount stage 1 changed it (before 1368 the
# modifier is written again with it), oe_yr_settled off, stage 0, the hold and the stage's "hold on" cleared.
oe_yr_fall_back = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut1_amt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg subtract = global_var:oe_yr_cut1_amt } }
        oe_yr_set_strife = yes
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut1_amt } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut1_amt }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
}
# Any scope. Every stage undone (the abandonment and the test reset). PHASE 2/3: stages 2 and 3 are undone first.
oe_yr_fall_back_all = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 } oe_yr_fall_back = yes }
}
# Any scope. Vanilla's intensity chi_rtr_modifier_intensity on the Yuan changed by global oe_yr_arg, written as vanilla's
# chi_adjust_pre_rtr_modifiers writes it (unset counts as 1; here unset counts as 1 plus this line's earlier changes), kept in
# 0-2; the change actually made goes to oe_yr_last_d and is added to oe_yr_int_d; then the modifier follows.
oe_yr_set_strife = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_int_d } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_int_d value = 0 } }
        c:CHI = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity } } set_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity value = oe_yr_int_base } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_tmp value = var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity }
            change_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity add = global_var:oe_yr_arg }
            clamp_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity min = 0 max = 2 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last_d value = var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last_d subtract = global_var:oe_yr_tmp }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_int_d add = global_var:oe_yr_last_d }
            remove_global_variable = oe_yr_tmp
            oe_yr_strife_mod = yes
        }
    }
}
# Country scope (the Yuan). Before 1368: vanilla's chi_factional_strife at the intensity, until 1368.1.1, replacing the one
# the start gave (mode = replace); at intensity 0 it comes off. From 1368 the start's modifier has ended: nothing to write.
oe_yr_strife_mod = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1368.1.1 has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity > 0 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = chi_factional_strife months = oe_yr_strife_months mode = replace size = var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = chi_factional_strife has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity <= 0 }
        remove_country_modifier = chi_factional_strife
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly. Vanilla removes the intensity when the Red Turban situation ends (red_turban_rebellions.txt on_ended);
# Y3's loyalty target then reads 1 again. While this line has changed it, it is written back as 1 plus the change.
oe_yr_resync = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_int_d NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_int_d = 0 } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { NOT = { has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity } } }
        c:CHI = { set_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity value = oe_yr_int_base } }
    }
}
# Any scope. From 1368 on (vanilla's two modifiers have ended) a stage passed gives oe_yr_settled: monthly_legitimacy +0.02, 13 months, renewed each January (mode = replace) (design 3.4).
oe_yr_settled_apply = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 1368.1.1 has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1 has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_settled months = 13 mode = replace } } }
    }
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- events: senders and the pick (Y4 / Y1 / y7 pattern)
oe_yr_fire_1 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ask1 value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 1 }
    oe_yr_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yr: event oe_yr.1 sent to CHI"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yr.1 } }
}
oe_yr_fire_2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } } oe_yr_pass_1 = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 2 }
    oe_yr_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yr: event oe_yr.2 sent to CHI"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yr.2 } }
}
oe_yr_fire_7 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ask7 value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 7 }
    oe_yr_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yr: event oe_yr.7 sent to CHI"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yr.7 } }
}

# Any scope. At most one event a month (.7, then .2, then .1). Nothing in a month in which another Yuan line already sent
# the Yuan an event, but a due event waits at most 2 such months.
oe_yr_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yr_busy = no global_var:oe_yr_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 0 oe_yr_busy = yes oe_yr_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 1 } oe_yr_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 2 } oe_yr_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 7 } oe_yr_fire_7 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yr_pick
}
# Any scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (button yrlog).
oe_yr_log = { debug_log = "oe_yr m=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_m')|0] end=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_end')|0] how=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_how')|0] path=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_path')|0] stage=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_stage')|0] ok=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_ok')|0]/[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_need')|0] hold=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_hold')|0] # ---- worker jobs (hidden event oe_yr.20, CHI scope; country var oe_yr_job). No debug_log here (CMDLOG: options reach them).
oe_yr_job_1 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_path value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 0 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } }
oe_yr_job_2 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_path value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 0 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } }
oe_yr_job_3 = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer add = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer_m add = 12 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } }
oe_yr_job_4 = { oe_yr_fall_back = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 4 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } }
oe_yr_job_5 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 6 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } }

# ---- TEST ONLY (DEV_LINES; the current player's country scope)
# For the CURRENT player's country when it is the Yuan (r21: an event sent to the AI Yuan cannot be read): runs the event's
# sender and sends the event to that country; the event's own trigger still applies.
oe_yr_test_me_1 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } } oe_yr_test_open = yes } oe_yr_fire_1 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yr.1 not sent" } }
oe_yr_test_me_2 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now } oe_yr_fire_2 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yr.2 not sent" } }
oe_yr_test_me_7 = { if = { limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now } oe_yr_fire_7 = yes } else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yr.7 not sent" } }
# The line from now on: everything cleared (vanilla's modifiers put back), then the start (the date and a Mongol Yuan apply).
oe_yr_test_start = {
    oe_yr_test_clear = yes
    oe_yr_setup = yes
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
# One month of the line now (the scheduler's call).
oe_yr_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } } oe_yr_monthly = yes oe_yr_log = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the line is not running (press yrstart first)" }
}
# The restoration opened now whatever the date and the ways (recorded as way 3, "遏制"); .1 becomes due.
oe_yr_test_open = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun value = 24 }
        oe_yr_do_open = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 3 }
    }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
# Usage: oe_yr_test_path = { n = 1|2 }: the road set directly (opened first if needed), the stage-1 count starts.
oe_yr_test_path = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } } oe_yr_test_open = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_path value = $n$ }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 }
    }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
# The checklist held for one month less than needed (next month .2 if it still holds).
oe_yr_test_ok = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 5 } oe_yr_log = yes }
# Stage 1 passed now, with its reward, without the event (a road must be set: yrpath1 or yrpath2).
oe_yr_test_stage1 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } } oe_yr_pass_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: needs a running line with a road at stage 0 (yrstart, yrpath1 or yrpath2)" }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
# The strain one short of the limit (next month: .7, or the abandonment before stage 1, if any signal holds).
oe_yr_test_strain = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 11 } oe_yr_log = yes }
# The restoration abandoned now (reason 1); the notice follows at the next monthly round (yrmonth).
oe_yr_test_fail = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes } oe_yr_abort = { why = 1 } }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the restoration is not open (yrstart, yropen)" }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
# Probe (design 5.1 item 6 a): vanilla's chi_administration_in_disarray (the start's timed modifier) removed from the Yuan,
# with the reading before and after. It is phase 2's reward: test games only.
oe_yr_test_disarray = {
    debug_log = "oe_yr probe before: mods=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_mods')|0] (tens = disarray)"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray } remove_country_modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray } } }
    debug_log = "oe_yr probe after: mods=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_mods')|0] (look again after the month turns)"
}
# Probe (design 5.1 item 6 c): vanilla's policy focus_on_classics added to the Middle Kingdom from the Yuan's scope, as
# vanilla flavor_chi.26 a writes it (phase 2's .6 uses it). Test games only.
oe_yr_test_policy = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI international_organization:middle_kingdom ?= { leader_country = c:CHI } }
        c:CHI = { international_organization:middle_kingdom = { add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:focus_on_classics } }
        debug_log = "oe_yr probe: focus_on_classics added to the Middle Kingdom (look at the organisation's policies)"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr probe: the Yuan does not lead the Middle Kingdom" }
}
# Everything of this line cleared: vanilla's modifiers put back by what this line changed, this line's modifiers off; the
# line starts again at the next monthly round.
oe_yr_test_clear = {
    oe_yr_fall_back_all = yes
    oe_yr_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
